title: fix: failed url context leak temporary directory
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

> /kind bug
> /kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

ForURL creates a temporary directory for a remote build context and removes it on failure. However, on error the tempDir var is set to "" before the deferred function runs, so `os.RemoveAll("")` did nothing and the directory is left.

#### How to verify it

go test -run TestForURLFailedDownloadCleanup -v ./pkg/tmpdir/

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #7175
